title: Liesrs Horror
description: A dark survival horror game where you are hunted by a deadly flying monster.
body:
## About the game
**Liesrs Horror** is an intense survival horror game where every action you take can be your last. You find yourself trapped, becoming the target of a creepy flying monster. 

### Features:
* **The constant threat:** The creature doesn't just wander around — it actively tracks you down from the air.
* **The atmosphere of fear:** The oppressive ambient and limited visibility will make you flinch at every rustle.
* **Goal:** Survive at all costs, using the environment to escape from the deadly pursuer.

Will you be able to solve the mystery of this place or will you become another victim of a monster that can fly and kill without warning?
